services.desc: Our Captains have earned USCG Masters licenses and have vast knowledge of the area waterways. This experience ensures both safety and enjoyment on every trip we serve. In addition we offer tutorial charters for anglers who own boats and would like to maximize the “tricks of the trade” in catching more fish and utilizing their boats to the fullest potential.
